name: markdownos
title: MarkdownOS
description: Quick actions for MarkdownOS, right from Raycast.
author: azlandotgg

commands.name: search-bookmarks
commands.title: Search Bookmarks
commands.description: Search, edit, archive, and delete your MarkdownOS bookmarks.

commands.name: save-bookmark
commands.title: Save Bookmark
commands.description: Save a URL as a MarkdownOS bookmark, with an optional title.

commands.name: save-tab
commands.title: Save Current Tab
commands.description: Save the active browser tab as a MarkdownOS bookmark.

commands.name: search-notes
commands.title: Search Notes
commands.description: Search your MarkdownOS notes, open one in the app, copy it, or delete it.

commands.name: new-note
commands.title: Create Note
commands.description: Create an empty MarkdownOS note and open it in a new window.

commands.name: open-bookmarks
commands.title: Open Bookmarks
commands.description: Open the Bookmarks section in MarkdownOS.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: MarkdownOS Menu Bar
commands.description: Create a note, search notes or bookmarks, or open the app — from a menu bar icon.
